name: Authorise.Net CIM Manager
description: Creates and updates Authorize.Net Customer Information Manager (CIM) payment profiles.
project_description:
The AuthNet CIM Manager module simplifies the creation and management of Customer Information Manager (CIM) profiles on Authorize.Net for Drupal websites. Easily capture and manage customer details to streamline payment processing and enhance security.

 Features 
 
 Basic Functionality : Capture and store customer details directly on Authorize.Net. 
 Unique Features : Seamless integration with Drupal, efficient creation of CIM profiles, enhanced security for payment processing. 
 Use Cases : Perfect for businesses needing to securely manage customer information and streamline payment processing on Drupal websites. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, follow these steps to configure it and start using it effectively:

 
 Access Configuration Page : Go to the modules configuration page in your Drupal administration interface. 
 Set Authorize.Net API Key : Enter your Authorize.Net API key in the designated field to establish the connection with Authorize.Net. 
 Place CIM Creation Form : The module provides a CIM creation form as a block. Place this block anywhere on your website to allow users to fill in customer details and create CIM profiles effortlessly 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This project requires the Authorize.Net PHP SDK, which is automatically installed via Composer during setup.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 No additional modules or libraries are needed for this project.
